part_identity_algorithm: SHA-1 over ASCII "blob " + decimal byte length + NUL + part bytes; no Git object was written.
purpose: Lossless serialization and integrity preparation only; publication and independent fidelity are separate.
reassembly: Concatenate parts in numeric order; resulting bytes must match archive.sha256 and archive.bytes.
